title: Remove policy justification from core records and storage APIs
outcome: Remove policy justification from core records and storage APIs
acceptance: Core callsites and Rust library tests compile and assert reason-free records while retaining policy/CAS/replay/authority invariants; no canonical history rewriting or live-store mutation.

ProjectPolicyAuthorityDecision and all policy-admin/explicit bootstrap storage APIs no longer carry, validate or manufacture a policy-change reason; policy-operation fingerprint fields are removed accordingly, without compatibility branches.

completion.summary: Removed policy-change justification from the core authority record, all three policy administration APIs and fingerprints, and explicit bootstrap while preserving actor attribution, CAS/idempotency behavior, immutable historical bytes, and healthy policy-history advancement. Updated owned Rust callsites/tests; combined gates and paired review passed.
